$comment: Allows only flags that narrow or sort ripgrep's default project file list; omitting flags runs rg --files with inherited ripgrep config disabled.
title: Forge rg files tool input

flags.description: Optional ripgrep flags in CLI order: --glob=PATTERN, --iglob=PATTERN, --glob=!PATTERN, --iglob=!PATTERN, --max-depth=N, --type=TYPE, --type-not=TYPE, --sort=path. Globs narrow the default file list without exposing hidden or ignored files.
